licence_proof: data.grandlyon.com publishes its datasets under the Licence Ouverte / Open Licence, which permits commercial reuse with attribution to the Métropole de Lyon. Same licence family already proven for Strasbourg, Rouen and Toulouse in the 2026-08-13 France sweep, where the finding recorded was that 'Licence Ouverte' means what it says.
scope: 429 protected remarkable trees across the Métropole de Lyon, per-tree point coordinates.
caveat: The layer is a PLANNING prescription rather than a botanical register, so an entry can be a small stand rather than one trunk: 'essence' sometimes names a genus and 'etat_phytosanitaire' sometimes says 'deux arbres'. Read both fields before treating a row as one collectible point. etat_phytosanitaire IS a condition field, written as free prose rather than a code, so it needs reading rather than filtering. No age and no girth.
